survivors.name: Ottilie Frayne
survivors.backstory: Former municipal greenhouse superintendent. Founded The Works to preserve seed genetic diversity across the long winter.
survivors.confession: Burned thirty boxes of civilian mail before the Exchange to keep the seed germinators warm in the sub-zero basement.

survivors.name: Anneke Ruhl
survivors.backstory: Hydraulic technician who installed the brass flow meters on the northern aqueduct. Knows the bypass valves by memory.
survivors.confession: Falsified the water meter readings for a family in District 8, causing the Hydro-Barons to cut off their line during the winter freeze.

survivors.name: Corporal Felix Vane
survivors.backstory: Machine-gunner at Checkpoint Gamma who deserted after refusing to fire on starving civilians begging for rye flour.
survivors.confession: Left his squad's heavy machine gun and four thousand rounds of ammunition in an unbolted snowdrift cache.

survivors.name: Sister Martha
survivors.backstory: Former choir director who followed the Cult of the Ash Sign into the crater before fleeing the mass suicide pyres.
survivors.confession: Convinced three young novitiates that the blast ash would cleanse their sins, watching them walk into the crater zone.

survivors.name: Dr. Sarah Chen
survivors.backstory: Chief of surgery at the Sector 4 General Hospital. Survived in the basement operating theater on canned glucose and iodine.
survivors.confession: Rationed the last five ampoules of morphine to herself to stop the hand tremors while performing frostbite amputations.

survivors.name: Tomas Lind
survivors.backstory: Agronomy researcher who carried two vacuum dewars of rye rhizomes forty miles on a hand-drawn sled in -30°C.
survivors.confession: Stole thirty liters of liquid nitrogen from a hospital blood bank to keep his crop cuttings frozen.

survivors.name: Valeria Koss
survivors.backstory: Civilian bureaucrat who calculated calorie allotments for the Garrison. Can optimize shelter food stores to within 10 grams.
survivors.confession: Drafted Schedule 14 knowing that reducing civilian bread rations to 150 grams would result in eighty winter deaths.

survivors.name: Gunner Mikhail
survivors.backstory: Artillery conscript who fired 152mm howitzer batteries into Sector 4 settlements during the winter siege.
survivors.confession: Knowingly zeroed battery shells onto a crowded civilian rail station because his battery commander threatened him with a pistol.

survivors.name: Naomi Strand
survivors.backstory: Scavenger who strips copper telegraph lines and periscope prisms from high granite telephone towers.
survivors.confession: Cut the guy wire on an antenna mast that a competing scavenger was climbing to claim the copper wire below.

survivors.name: Pavel Volkov
survivors.backstory: Senior technician at Geothermal Well Alpha. Keeps high-pressure steam bypass loops from blowing their headers.
survivors.confession: Vented superheated steam into a flooded maintenance shaft where three looters were trapped to save the main manifold.

survivors.name: Zoya Reid
survivors.backstory: Researcher from the Low-Background Salt Lab. Formulates Prussian blue binders and monitors radon gas fissures.
survivors.confession: Concealed the fact that the surface well water had high Cesium-137 levels for two weeks to prevent mass panic.

survivors.name: Captain Alder
survivors.backstory: Commander of the Highway 12 relief convoys. Drove heavy halftracks through three black blizzards without losing a vehicle.
survivors.confession: Ordered an overloaded supply trailer with eight frostbitten refugees unhitched in a blizzard when the drive axle cracked.

survivors.name: Lydia Hart
survivors.backstory: Machinist at The Works who turns brass valve seats and grinds replacement quartz prisms for bunker periscopes.
survivors.confession: Sabotaged a Garrison lathe by introducing emery powder into the headstock gears before evacuating her shop.

survivors.name: Dr. Erik Dahl
survivors.backstory: Principal investigator at the Low-Background Salt Laboratory. Possesses the mathematical proof of the war's automated cause.
survivors.confession: Refused to share his lab's emergency battery banks with a nearby refugee cave, keeping his mass spectrometer powered.

survivors.name: Igor Morozov
survivors.backstory: Garrison sniper who held the railway cut for two months against raiders. Suffers from extreme hypervigilance.
survivors.confession: Shot two teenage girls foraging for coal along the railway embankment thinking they were cultist suicide scouts.

survivors.name: Clara Sloan
survivors.backstory: Assistant to Ottilie Frayne. Developed a nutrient solution using wood ash and bone meal that boosted greenhouse yields by 40%.
survivors.confession: Secretly fed half her daily bread ration to experimental rye seedlings in the dark storage room.

survivors.name: Vera Sokolov
survivors.backstory: Telegraph operator at Sector 4 Junction. Copied every military dispatch and evacuation manifest transmitted across the lines.
survivors.confession: Intercepted a priority evacuation train clearance for a hospital unit and failed to forward it, keeping the siding clear for a fuel train.

survivors.name: Marcus Vane
survivors.backstory: Amateur radio operator who built the 142.850 MHz long-wave receiver array from salvaged vacuum tubes and wire.
survivors.confession: Stole a silver solder spool from the Garrison signal bunker while under shelter arrest.

survivors.name: 1st Officer Lindqvist
survivors.backstory: Senior navigation officer sent ashore by the Aurora Borealis to verify shelter manifests and evaluate lead ice conditions.
survivors.confession: Denied boarding to forty uncertified dock refugees to preserve the icebreaker's fuel reserves for the return voyage.

survivors.name: Colonel Brand
survivors.backstory: Commander of Detachment 9. Held the railway cut under standing orders from a dead government for 240 days.
survivors.confession: Wired the viaduct charges with dead-man switches knowing that his own death would sever the valley's last transport link.

survivors.name: Ansel Duth
survivors.backstory: Chief clerk at the Kilometre 19 toll gates. Appraised salt cakes, ammunition, and fuel scrip for the Warlords.
survivors.confession: Shaved 5% of all silver and brass coin off the toll tax ledgers to buy himself a secure place in an upland cellar.

survivors.name: Hadi Morrow
survivors.backstory: Peat bog laborer who dug three hundred tons of fuel brick out of the frozen bogs to keep the Allotment boilers fired.
survivors.confession: Buried his frostbitten brother in the bog without a church burial to avoid stopping work on the fuel trenches.

survivors.name: Kess Adler
survivors.backstory: Trapper who hunts mutated snow hares and foxes in the crater buffer zones to trade pelts and meat.
survivors.confession: Sold irradiated hare meat to an upland refugee camp without telling them the animals were taken near Ground Zero.

survivors.name: Len Quill
survivors.backstory: Archivist who preserved Sector 4's civil land deeds, census rolls, and engineering blueprints in sealed zinc boxes.
survivors.confession: Erased twenty criminal records from the municipal ledger in exchange for three cans of condensed milk.

survivors.name: Chief Assayer Markov
survivors.backstory: Head of the High Granite Arsenal foundry. Kept the shell drop hammers stamping brass through sixty days of artillery sieges.
survivors.confession: Added 20% sand to the ammonium nitrate batches supplied to local militias to conserve high explosive reserves for the garrison.

survivors.name: Commander Talia
survivors.backstory: Elected commander of the Central Upland Defense League. Fortified the eastern terraces against Garrison motorized sweeps.
survivors.confession: Ordered the destruction of the lower mountain bridge, cutting off fifty farm families on the lower road to save the main redoubt.

survivors.name: Major Kroll
survivors.backstory: Enforcer of Martial Allocation Schedule 14. Commanded the punitive executions at Kilometre 12 to stop military collapse.
survivors.confession: Carries the signed execution orders for his own younger brother, who deserted from the 2nd Sentry Company.

survivors.name: Hierophant Malachi
survivors.backstory: Sole surviving high priest of the Vitrified Crater. Preached the liturgy of the Black Thaw to hundreds of doomed penitents.
survivors.confession: Survives by taking private chelation injections while forbidding his followers from taking medical treatment.

survivors.name: Sapper Vance
survivors.backstory: Convict pioneer who cleared radioactive unexploded ordnance with hand tools in the crater buffer zone.
survivors.confession: Rigged an unexploded 152mm shell into a booby trap behind his provost guards when his work gang mutinied.

survivors.name: Elena Vasquez
survivors.backstory: Leader of the railway union scouts. Maintains the armored handcars that smuggle grain past Garrison checkpoints.
survivors.confession: Switched a Garrison supply train onto a broken trestle bridge, drowning four conscript brakemen in the river.

survivors.name: Gregor the Salt Miner
survivors.backstory: Lead miner in the 400m salt caverns. Excavated the hospital rooms and blasted protective rock seals during the siege.
survivors.confession: Sealed three looters inside an unventilated drift when they attempted to steal the community's salt medicine reserves.

survivors.name: Marina Drake
survivors.backstory: Veteran convoy driver who hauled twenty tons of medical supplies and seed grain along Highway 12 through sniper fire.
survivors.confession: Ran down an armed barricade manned by teenage militia fighters without slowing down to deliver emergency antibiotics.

survivors.name: Yuri Belov
survivors.backstory: Master furnace operator who kept the bronze crucibles fired on charcoal during the height of the Deep Freeze.
survivors.confession: Burned thirty thousand wooden library archives from the municipal records building to maintain foundry furnace temperatures.

survivors.name: Nadia Brant
survivors.backstory: Upland runner who carried messages between terraced farmsteads in the dead of winter, evading Garrison patrols on skis.
survivors.confession: Left an injured Garrison courier to freeze in a snowbank rather than carry him to the nearest farm shelter.

survivors.name: Boris Kogan
survivors.backstory: Field medic sentenced to the penal battalion for anti-war agitation. Treated four hundred cases of acute radiation sickness in sump mud.
survivors.confession: Administered lethal potassium overdoses to twelve dying conscripts whose screaming was attracting mortar fire to their trench.

survivors.name: Anton Vane
survivors.backstory: Broker in the 400m salt exchange. Managed transactions between the Works, the Garrison, and the Hydro-Barons without taking sides.
survivors.confession: Took a 10% cut in grain from starving refugees in exchange for safe sleeping space in the salt cavern infirmary.
